ViTPose-Huge adapter sources and contracts

vitpose_tracking.py implements CPU inference for the official checkpoint:
td-hm_ViTPose-huge_8xb64-210e_coco-256x192-e32adcd4_20230314.pth

Architecture reference (OpenMMLab, Apache-2.0):
https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmpretrain/blob/main/mmpretrain/models/backbones/vision_transformer.py
https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmpretrain/blob/main/mmpretrain/models/utils/attention.py
https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmpose/blob/main/mmpose/models/heads/heatmap_heads/heatmap_head.py

Model configuration:
https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmpose/blob/main/configs/body_2d_keypoint/topdown_heatmap/coco/td-hm_ViTPose-huge_8xb64-210e_coco-256x192.py

GolfPose club fine-tuning configuration and five-point schema:
https://github.com/MingHanLee/GolfPose/blob/main/configs/mmpose/golfpose_club_ViTPose_huge.py
https://github.com/MingHanLee/GolfPose/blob/main/configs/mmpose/_base_/datasets/golfswing_club.py

vitpose_udp.py is an inference-only extraction of get_heatmap_maximum,
gaussian_blur and refine_keypoints_dark_udp from installed MMPose 1.3.2:
mmpose/codecs/utils/post_processing.py
mmpose/codecs/utils/refinement.py
Copyright (c) OpenMMLab. All rights reserved. See MMPOSE_LICENSE.

Differences from the training runtime:
- All 404 released state tensors load strictly into the inference graph.
- The retained class token/position parameters are loaded; the class token
  is unused, as required by with_cls_token=False. Patch positions use slots 1:.
- Dropout and stochastic depth are omitted because they are identities in eval.
- PyTorch scaled_dot_product_attention runs the attention on CPU.
- Bounding boxes come from the preserved YOLO26n-pose checkpoint.
- Crop: bbox center/scale, 1.25 padding, 192:256 aspect, UDP affine.
- RGB normalization, original+flip averaging, 17 COCO heatmaps, UDP/DARK decode.
- Video association chooses matching box IoU >= 0.1, then largest-box fallback.
- The adapter emits existing Ultralytics-compatible pose results for the
  existing club segmentation and GolfPose joint conversion code.
- club_vitpose.py reuses the graph with the official five-channel fine-tuned
  head. Club segmentation supplies its crop; its ordered output is shaft,
  hosel, heel, toe_down and toe_up for the 17+5 lifter.
